reviews.text: They're my number one choice. They always treat my dog ​​very well and give her a great bath. They're very kind and attentive. Obviously, we visit them every week and we love it.
Terrible service from the staff in charge, who had no experience in hair cutting. Very unpunctual.

I took my two dogs for a bath and haircut, and there was a small mishap with one of them. The staff was always friendly and willing to take responsibility and follow up on my case. They also refunded me the full amount. I think it's important to highlight when businesses have this attitude of correcting these situations, as other places leave you to fend for yourself. Thank you.

I was a regular customer for a long time, and we never had any problems with the previous vet. But today, with a new vet, my dog ​​arrived with a horrible wound above his eye, and they refused to take responsibility, saying he arrived like that, even though we should have noticed such a large wound before bringing him in. For your dogs' safety, don't take them to this place.

If you want the worst grooming service for your dog, come to this place. The staff will greet you with appalling personal hygiene—unbathed, unshaven, and smelling like old, decaying food. Bring a face mask, for pity's sake! And well, if this is just the welcome, what awaits your pet will be the last memory you want of human negligence dedicated, if you can call it that, to this noble profession of grooming and caring for your pet. They won't be able to give your dog the breed-appropriate cut, not even with a photo or by holding their hand. They won't clean their ears, glands, or nails. They'll arrive looking like they've just arrived, obviously uncut, but shorn. Oh, but they do give you a form so that the sixth service—if you even get that far, which I doubt, given your intelligence—will be free! Take my advice, look for another option. They used to have qualified staff... they left, take care of your dog... Best regards!

I had better references for this place. I took my little Shih Tzu there in March and had no problems with the service. However, last week I took her back, showed them how I wanted the service, and they shaved her without any shaping. I contacted them via WhatsApp because, in addition to the grooming, I started noticing that after that day my dog ​​didn't want to eat, and I wanted to know if something had happened during the service. The only response I got was that if my dog ​​had knots, that was the cut they made (of course, she clearly didn't; that's something that should have been mentioned from the beginning). Regarding whether something had happened, they told me that if it had, they would have reported it, but that if I wanted, they could send a vet to my house.

To date, they haven't bothered to verify or give me an answer as to why they performed that service or if there was any incident with my little one. After the evaluation by her veterinarian, who determined that she possibly fell due to pain in her hip, she is fortunately fine. But obviously, after this, I absolutely do not recommend the place. It's a shame that they tell you they'll be following up on any issues regarding your service and then offer no further solutions.

I don't recommend them. My dog ​​came out with a bump on her eye, and they only put a few chamomile drops in it. Besides that, when they gave her back to me, they put all her fur in her eyes so I couldn't see the bump. I checked her and asked them what had happened, and they just said she probably hit it from moving around. They really lost a customer because I used to bring two dogs. Don't go to them.

On my last visit, I wasn't happy with the service. They didn't fill out the dog's registration card, which I believe is a necessary procedure. I didn't like the service they provided; it was a bad experience.
I highly recommend them; they take care of my cats whenever I travel. They've been doing this for several years. They also care for dogs. Highly recommended.

They're very professional, it's not as expensive as other places, and it's worth every penny 🩷
I think the service could be improved, but it's not bad 🫶🏻 …
